verdict: An existing MECM client is already installed. ccmsetup will not downgrade or reinstall side-by-side without an explicit force.
fix: If the existing client is broken or stale, uninstall it cleanly first: `ccmsetup.exe /uninstall` (wait for `CCMCLEAN` to finish). Then run `ccmsetup.exe /forceinstall` for the current version. Do not skip the uninstall step; a partial uninstall leaves registry and WMI state that will cause the next install to fail with 1603.
